Lecture transcript: Managing atrial fibrillation in older adults
Recorded on 14 October 2026.

Dr. Maria Okafor: Good morning. Today we look at the trial we ran with 312 patients over 18 months.
For rate control we started metoprolol at 25 mg twice a day and went up to 100 mg if needed.
For anticoagulation, apixaban 5 mg twice a day was the standard dose, reduced to 2.5 mg
for patients over 80 years or under 60 kg.
Warfarin was kept for patients with mechanical valves, aiming at an INR of 2 to 3.
Stroke fell by 38% in the apixaban group. Major bleeding was 2.1% against 3.4% with warfarin.
Prof. Daniel Reyes will present the follow-up data in March 2027.
